build_medusa_draft_model: build a Medusa draft model for speculative decoding with configurable residual blocks and parallel LM heads
create_residual_block: create a residual block with configurable layers, hidden size, and SiLU activation for Medusa draft model
run_medusa_forward: run the Medusa model forward pass to generate proposal hidden states from input hidden states
compute_medusa_logits: compute logits from Medusa draft model hidden states using parallel LM heads and optional token map
load_medusa_weights: load trained weights into a Medusa draft model including token map and parallel LM head parameters
